helpPlace: place <0/1/2>            place the pending card on a row (0=front, 1=middle, 2=back)
helpFront: front / f                 place on the front row
helpMiddle: middle / m                place on the middle row
helpBack: back / b                  place on the back row
promptPlaceHelp: place <0/1/2> ... keep back >= middle >= front (breaking it fouls your hand).
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... go to next round
hintReasonStrongBack: strong card: place on the back row to build a solid foundation
hintReasonWeakFront: weak card: place on the front row
hintReasonBalance: place for balance given how the rows are filling
helpExampleFront: front                     put the pending card on the front row
